title: Think Hard Only When Needed: A Hybrid Best-of-N and Beam Search for Efficient Test-Time Compute
authors_zh: Hyewon Suh、Chaojian Li、Cheng-Jhih Shih、Zheng Wang、Kejing Xia、Yonggan Fu、Yingyan Celine Lin（机构：佐治亚理工学院）
paper_type_zh: 自适应混合测试时计算研究
best_for_zh: 服务批量大小为一的推理负载、且必须平衡并行采样吞吐与束搜索顺序评分成本的读者。
one_line: THROW uses early PRM scores to spend less search on easy prompts and selectively expand promising branches for hard ones.
THROW 利用早期过程奖励模型分数，让简单提示少花搜索预算，并为困难提示选择性扩展有前景的分支。
why: It turns query difficulty into a concrete switching rule between two common search families instead of applying the same compute budget to every prompt.
inclusion_reason: It allocates test-time computation conditionally by using early PRM evidence to choose between branch pruning and branch expansion, directly optimizing accuracy, tokens, and latency.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Best-of-N sampling is highly parallel but completes every trajectory, including ones that already look unpromising. Process-reward-guided beam search can focus on stronger partial chains, but repeatedly invoking a reward model creates sequential overhead and poor batch-1 latency. Applying either method uniformly ignores that some prompts need little deliberation while others need selective refinement.

The paper asks how a test-time system can decide early whether to stop wasting branches or invest more search in a difficult question. The decision must be made from incomplete traces, not from an oracle difficulty label, and it must account for both policy-model decoding and process-reward scoring. The desired procedure should retain sampling diversity where it helps, but reserve expensive stepwise expansion for cases where short initial reasoning provides evidence that it is justified.

最佳候选采样具有很强的并行性，却会完成每一条轨迹，包括那些已经显得没有前景的轨迹。过程奖励引导的束搜索能够聚焦较强的部分推理链，但反复调用奖励模型会带来顺序开销和较差的批量大小为一时延。无论采用哪一种方法，都忽略了有些提示几乎不需要深思，而另一些提示才需要选择性细化这一差异。

论文研究测试时系统如何及早决定：是停止浪费分支，还是为困难问题投入更多搜索。该决策必须来自不完整轨迹，而不能使用预知的问题难度标签，并且必须同时计入策略模型解码和过程奖励评分。理想过程应在多样性有帮助时保留采样，却只把昂贵的逐步扩展留给短初始推理已经显示其值得的情况。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
THROW combines the complementary behaviors of sampling and beam search in a two-stage policy. It first draws several deliberately short partial trajectories. A process reward model scores them, and the share that clears a score threshold becomes a difficulty indicator: many weak partial paths mean the prompt is treated as hard; enough strong paths mean it is treated as easy.

The second stage sends those two cases in opposite directions. Easy prompts undergo branch truncation, retaining only a few high-scoring candidates instead of finishing every sample. Hard prompts undergo controlled branch expansion from the best partial paths, concentrating extra decoding where it can repair a weak initial attempt. In this way, the same early evidence changes both the number of active branches and the amount of test-time compute spent on a prompt.

THROW 在两阶段策略中结合了采样与束搜索互补的行为。它先生成若干刻意较短的部分轨迹，再由过程奖励模型为其评分；超过分数阈值的分支比例构成难度指标：弱部分路径很多时，提示被视为困难；足够多路径较强时，则被视为简单。

第二阶段让两类情况走向相反的处理。简单提示执行分支截断，只保留少数高分候选，而不完成所有样本；困难提示则从最好的部分路径开始受控地扩展分支，把额外解码集中到能够修复薄弱初步尝试的位置。这样，同一份早期证据同时改变了活跃分支数量和每个提示获得的测试时计算量。

title: Method
方法
html:
Stage I generates partial traces of 350 tokens, scores each branch with Qwen2.5-Math-PRM-7B, and calculates the fraction that fall below a threshold. A second threshold classifies the query as easy or hard. For easy cases, only the top K branches survive. For hard cases, top branches are expanded by a configured multiplier. The authors give a compute analysis showing savings whenever the total second-stage branches remain below the original sample count, with further savings from fewer repeated PRM calls than beam search.

The main experiments use Qwen2.5 1.5B and 3B instruction models on one A100 GPU, with maximum output length 2,048 and temperature 0.7. MATH500, AMC23, and AIME24 are evaluated against Best-of-N and PRM beam search at 8, 16, and 32 candidates. Substituting a Llama PRM and a Llama policy model tests whether the result depends on the particular Qwen model pair, while ablations measure the difficulty indicator and random rather than informed branch selection.

第一阶段生成长度为 350 个词元的部分轨迹，用 Qwen2.5-Math-PRM-7B 为每条分支评分，并计算低于阈值的分支比例。第二个阈值将提示划分为简单或困难。对简单情况，只保留排名前 K 的分支；对困难情况，从最佳分支按配置倍数扩展。作者给出计算量分析：只要第二阶段分支总数低于原始样本数，就能节省策略模型计算；相较束搜索，减少反复过程奖励调用还会带来额外节省。

主要实验使用一张 A100 GPU 上的 Qwen2.5 1.5B 和 3B 指令模型，最大输出长度为 2,048，温度为 0.7。在 MATH500、AMC23 和 AIME24 上，以 8、16 和 32 个候选对比最佳候选采样和过程奖励束搜索。替换 Llama 过程奖励模型与 Llama 策略模型，用来检验结果是否依赖特定 Qwen 组合；消融实验则测量难度指标，以及随机而非有信息的分支选择。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
With Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct, averaged over the reported candidate counts and math benchmarks, THROW is 1.54 times faster than Best-of-N and 14.38 times faster than beam search, with 35.7% and 80.4% fewer generated tokens respectively. It improves average accuracy by 1.1 points over Best-of-N and stays within 0.9 points of beam search. At 16 paths on AIME24, its latency is 7.31 seconds and 8,881 tokens, versus 10.78 seconds and 14,916 tokens for Best-of-N and 112.17 seconds and 57,973 tokens for beam search.

The 3B policy model shows the same trade-off: 1.51 and 11.86 times latency speedups and 37.1% and 79.3% token reductions relative to the two baselines, with a 2.4-point average gain over Best-of-N. The difficulty indicator correlates with pass-at-one difficulty at absolute Pearson correlations from 0.679 to 0.801. On MATH500, informed branch selection reaches 0.722 accuracy at 16 paths, five points above random selection, supporting the claim that the savings come from allocation rather than arbitrary pruning.

使用 Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct 时，在文中报告的候选数和数学基准上平均计算，THROW 比最佳候选采样快 1.54 倍、比束搜索快 14.38 倍，生成词元分别减少 35.7% 和 80.4%。它比最佳候选采样平均准确率高 1.1 个百分点，与束搜索相差不超过 0.9 个百分点。在 AIME24 的 16 路设置中，它的时延为 7.31 秒、词元为 8,881 个；最佳候选采样为 10.78 秒和 14,916 个，束搜索为 112.17 秒和 57,973 个。

3B 策略模型也呈现相同权衡：相对两个基线分别有 1.51 倍和 11.86 倍时延加速，以及 37.1% 和 79.3% 的词元减少；相对最佳候选采样平均提高 2.4 个百分点。难度指标与通过一次采样的难度之间的皮尔逊相关系数绝对值为 0.679 到 0.801。在 MATH500 上，有信息的分支选择在 16 路时达到 0.722 准确率，比随机选择高五个百分点，支持节省来自分配而不是任意剪枝这一结论。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The novelty is the bidirectional use of an early process-reward signal. Prior pipelines generally make a fixed commitment to either finish many independent samples or repeatedly score and expand beams. THROW instead treats partial-trace quality as a prompt-level budget signal: the very same measurement causes compute to contract for easy prompts and expand for hard prompts.

This is more specific than generic early exit because it preserves a path for additional deliberation when it is needed. Its hybrid design makes the comparison operational: it reports policy decoding, PRM overhead, tokens, and batch-1 wall-clock latency rather than only an accuracy-at-budget curve. The result frames the practical objective as selectively moving between diversity and targeted refinement, not simply making either constituent search method cheaper.

新意在于双向使用早期过程奖励信号。已有流程通常固定承诺于两种路线之一：完成许多独立样本，或反复评分并扩展束。THROW 则将部分轨迹质量视为提示级预算信号：同一个测量会让简单提示收缩计算，让困难提示扩展计算。

这比一般的早退更具体，因为在需要时它仍保留额外深思的路径。其混合设计使比较具有可操作性：它报告策略解码、过程奖励开销、词元数和批量大小为一时的实际时延，而不只给出某一预算下的准确率曲线。结果把实践目标表述为在多样性和定向细化之间选择性切换，而不只是让任一组成搜索方法变得更便宜。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The method still requires a separately served PRM, so the savings depend on the verifier being informative enough to justify its initial scoring cost. Thresholds, branch counts, and the 350-token first stage are tuned by grid search and may not transfer unchanged. Results focus on math and streaming batch-1 inference; the paper does not establish multi-request throughput behavior, non-mathematical generalization, or a code release that would settle implementation details.
该方法仍需部署独立过程奖励模型，因此节省效果取决于验证器是否足够有信息量，足以抵消其初始评分成本。阈值、分支数和 350 词元的第一阶段均通过网格搜索调节，未必能原样迁移。结果聚焦数学和流式批量大小为一的推理；论文没有证明多请求吞吐行为、非数学泛化，也未发布能厘清实现细节的代码。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this paper when choosing between parallel self-consistency and PRM-guided beam search in an interactive service. It offers a clear evaluation recipe: collect early partial traces, test whether their reward distribution predicts difficulty, and report a latency-token-accuracy trade-off under the actual serving batch size. It is most useful where PRM calls are available but expensive, not where no reliable process scorer exists.
当交互式服务需要在并行自一致性和过程奖励束搜索之间选择时，可使用这篇论文。它给出清晰的评估配方：收集早期部分轨迹，检验其奖励分布是否预测难度，并在真实服务批量大小下报告时延—词元—准确率权衡。它最适用于过程奖励调用可用但昂贵的场景，而不适用于没有可靠过程评分器的场景。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read the latency breakdown and PRM substitution results before treating the speedups as model-independent. The strongest reusable idea is not the exact thresholds but the two-sided allocation rule: retain fewer branches after good early evidence, and increase search only after poor evidence. Re-evaluate the rule with the intended verifier and request pattern because the claimed advantage relies on streaming batch-1 scheduling.
在把加速结论视为与模型无关之前，应先阅读时延分解和过程奖励替换结果。最强的可复用想法不是精确阈值，而是双向分配规则：早期证据较好后保留更少分支，早期证据较差时才增加搜索。应使用目标验证器和请求模式重新评估该规则，因为论文宣称的优势依赖流式批量大小为一的调度。
